newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ciadea upgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ciadea upgraded to hold.

text.p: - Credit Lyonnais Securities Inc. said it upgraded Argentine automaker Ciadea to "hold" from "sell".

- "The upgrade is based on our expectation of a change in control of the company, a steadily improving operating margin, and the possibility that Q4 1996 results will include the reversal of provisions which will flow directly to the bottom line," said Credit Lyonnais.
- Credit Lyonnais said it is more than likely that Renault will buy operating control from local businessman Manuel Antelo in the short-term.
- It predicted an EPS of $0.48 in 1996, $0.43 in 1997 and $0.51 in 1998.
